name: MyGene_query_genes
description: Search MyGene.info with explicit offset pagination. Pages may contain up to 1000 records. BioThings exposes at most the first 10,000 matches through offset pagination; metadata distinguishes total_results from accessible_results and reports upstream_truncated when the query must be narrowed or partitioned. Use a stable sort such as sort='entrezgene' across pages.

query.description: Search query. Can be gene symbol (e.g., 'CDK2'), name ('cyclin dependent kinase'), Entrez ID ('1017'), or Ensembl ID ('ENSG00000123374'). Supports wildcards (*) and boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT).

species.description: Species filter. Use common name or NCBI taxonomy ID. Examples: 'human', 'mouse', '9606' (human), 'all'.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Common fields: symbol, name, entrezgene, ensembl.gene, summary, go, pathway, interpro.

size.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-1000). offset + size may not exceed 10,000.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset within BioThings' first-10,000 window. Continue with metadata.next_offset while non-null.

sort.description: Optional upstream sort field. Use 'entrezgene' for stable exhaustive pagination; omit to preserve relevance ranking.

name: MyGene_get_gene_annotation
description: Get detailed annotation for a specific gene by its ID (Entrez or Ensembl). Returns comprehensive information including gene ontology, pathways, protein domains, and literature references.

gene_id.description: Gene ID to query. Can be Entrez Gene ID (e.g., '1017' for CDK2) or Ensembl ID (e.g., 'ENSG00000123374').

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Available fields include: symbol, name, summary, go (gene ontology), pathway (KEGG/Reactome), interpro (protein domains), generif (gene references), pdb, uniprot.

translation.description: Ensembl protein/transcript pairs, each {protein, rna}. Which protein each transcript makes.

type_of_gene.description: Ensembl's gene biotype, e.g. 'protein_coding'. A pseudogene and a coding gene are not interchangeable and only this says which.

pathway.description: Pathway annotations from KEGG, Reactome, WikiPathways

generif.description: GeneRIF statements, each a pubmed id and a one-line finding. 370 on TP53 - the curated sentence-level literature on what the gene does.

name: MyGene_batch_query
description: Query multiple genes at once using a list of gene identifiers. Efficient for retrieving annotations for a gene set or performing ID mapping between different gene ID types.

gene_ids.description: List of gene IDs to query. Can mix different ID types (Entrez, Ensembl, symbols).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each gene.

notfound.description: True if gene was not found

_score.description: Relevance score for the hit; results come back in descending order of it.

name: MyVariant_query_variants
description: Search for genetic variants by various criteria including rsID, gene, chromosome position, or clinical significance. Returns variant annotations from sources like dbSNP, ClinVar, gnomAD, and CADD. Coordinates default to hg19/GRCh37 -- set assembly='hg38' for hg38/GRCh38 (e.g. rs4244285 is chr10:g.96541616G>C on hg19 and chr10:g.94781859G>C on hg38). Any HGVS coordinate in the query must be written in the assembly you request; an rsID works in either. The response reports the frame in a top-level 'coordinate_assembly' key. Results use explicit offset pagination with pages up to 1000 records. BioThings exposes at most the first 10,000 matches through offset pagination; metadata distinguishes total_results from accessible_results and reports upstream_truncated when a broad query must be narrowed or partitioned. Use a stable sort such as sort='vcf.position' across pages.

query.description: Search query. Examples: 'rs58991260' (rsID), 'chr7:g.55249071G>A' (HGVS), 'clinvar.gene.symbol:BRCA1' (gene in ClinVar), 'cadd.phred:>30' (high CADD score).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Common: dbsnp, clinvar, cadd, gnomad_genome, dbnsfp.

size.description: Maximum number of results (1-1000). offset + size may not exceed 10,000.

assembly.description: Reference genome assembly for the coordinates in the query and in the results: 'hg19' (GRCh37, the default) or 'hg38' (GRCh38).

offset.description: Zero-based result offset within BioThings' first-10,000 window. Continue with metadata.next_offset while non-null.

sort.description: Optional upstream sort field. Use 'vcf.position' for stable exhaustive pagination; omit to preserve relevance ranking.

_license.description: Licence URL for the dbSNP data.

dbsnp_build.description: dbSNP build the record comes from, e.g. 156. rsIDs are merged and retired between builds, so this dates the record.

hg19.description: The variant's hg19/GRCh37 coordinates, as start and end. The top-level coordinates are hg38, so this is what a GRCh37 pipeline needs - and conflating the two is a silent error.

alleles.description: dbSNP's allele records for the variant, each with the allele and its frequency observations. The variant's own ref/alt are the single pair; this is every allele dbSNP has seen at the position.

1000g.description: 1000 Genomes allele frequencies as CADD recorded them, overall and per super-population (afr, amr, eur).

_license.description: Licence URL for the CADD data.

anc.description: Inferred ancestral allele, e.g. 'G'. Differs from `ref` where the reference carries the derived allele.

annotype.description: What the position is, e.g. 'Intergenic', 'CodingTranscript'. The context every other CADD field has to be read in.

bstatistic.description: Background-selection statistic, e.g. 802. Low values mean strong linked selection.

chmm.description: ChromHMM state coverage at the position, keyed by state (enh, het, quies, tssa and the rest). The regulatory context.

consequence.description: CADD's consequence term for the variant, e.g. 'DOWNSTREAM', 'NON_SYNONYMOUS'.

cpg.description: CpG content of the surrounding window.

dna.description: DNA shape features at the position: helt, mgw, prot, roll.

encode.description: ENCODE signal at the position: h3k27ac, h3k4me1, h3k4me3 and nucleosome occupancy.

fitcons.description: fitCons functional-constraint score, e.g. 0.065712: the fraction of sites in this class under selection.

gc.description: GC content of the surrounding window, e.g. 0.29.

gerp.description: GERP constraint scores: `n` the neutral rate and `s` the observed substitution deficit.

isderived.description: 'TRUE' when the alternate allele is the derived one.

isknownvariant.description: 'TRUE' when the variant was already in the training data - a CADD score on a known variant is not an independent prediction.

istv.description: 'TRUE' for a transversion, 'FALSE' for a transition.

length.description: Length of the change; 0 for a substitution.

mapability.description: Mappability at 20bp and 35bp read lengths. Low mappability means the call itself is less trustworthy, which is a caveat on everything else.

min_dist_tse.description: Distance to the nearest transcription end site.

min_dist_tss.description: Distance to the nearest transcription start site, e.g. 24354.

motif.description: Transcription-factor motif evidence: distance to the motif and how much it overlaps.

phast_cons.description: PhastCons conservation probabilities, per clade: mammalian, primate, vertebrate.

phylop.description: PhyloP conservation scores, per clade: mammalian, primate, vertebrate. Positive means conserved. One of the main inputs to the CADD score, and a caller checking whether a position is constrained needs it directly.

rawscore.description: CADD's raw deleteriousness score, e.g. -0.106892. Unscaled: compare it only within one CADD version. The PHRED-scaled form is the one usually quoted, and neither was declared.

segway.description: Segway genome-segmentation label for the position, e.g. 'F0'.

_score.description: This hit's relevance score; hits come back in descending order of it.

gnomad_genome.description: gnomAD genome frequencies for the variant: overall allele frequency, allele count and number, and the per-population breakdown. An allele that is rare overall and common in one population is the case this block exists to show.

max_score.description: Highest relevance score among the hits, from MyVariant's Elasticsearch backend.

name: MyVariant_get_variant_annotation
description: Get detailed annotations for a specific variant by its HGVS ID (e.g., 'chr1:g.2186318G>A') or rsID. Returns information from dbSNP, ClinVar, CADD, and other sources. Coordinates default to hg19/GRCh37 -- set assembly='hg38' for hg38/GRCh38 (e.g. rs4244285 is chr10:g.96541616G>C on hg19 and chr10:g.94781859G>C on hg38). fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return. Common: drugbank, chebi, pubchem, chembl, drugcentral, unii.

size.description: Maximum number of results (1-1000). offset + size may not exceed 10,000.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset within BioThings' first-10,000 window. Continue with metadata.next_offset while non-null.

sort.description: Optional upstream sort field. Use 'pubchem.cid' for stable exhaustive pagination; omit to preserve relevance ranking.

drugbank.description: DrugBank's identifiers for the compound. The free MyChem feed carries identity only; a full record here is 8 keys.

additionalProperties.description: Any other key MyChem returns for this source. The caller's `fields` argument decides what the block holds, and the names above are the ones that answer a question rather than a closed list.

max_phase.description: Highest clinical phase reached: 4 is approved, 0 or null is preclinical. This is the field that answers 'is it a drug?' and it was undeclared.

first_approval.description: Year of first approval, when there is one.

black_box_warning.description: Whether the drug carries a boxed warning (1/0).

drug_indications.description: Indications ChEMBL records, with their MeSH and EFO terms and max phase.

atc_classifications.description: WHO ATC codes for the drug.

molecule_properties.description: Computed physicochemical properties: logP, polar surface area, rule-of-five violations and the rest.

molecule_synonyms.description: Synonyms with the source that uses each.

molecule_hierarchy.description: Parent and active-ingredient ids, for salts and prodrugs.

first_in_class.description: Whether ChEMBL records it as first in its class.

natural_product.description: Whether it is a natural product.

availability_type.description: Prescription status code: -1 unknown, 0 discontinued, 1 prescription only, 2 over the counter.

withdrawn_flag.description: Whether the drug has been withdrawn.

chembl.description: ChEMBL's record for the compound. Which keys appear depends on the `fields` argument; a full record carries 35.

undefined_chiral_atom_count.description: Stereocentres left undefined - non-zero means the record does not pin the stereochemistry down.

name: MyVariant_get_pathogenicity_scores
description: Get comprehensive pathogenicity prediction scores for a variant from dbNSFP. Returns REVEL, CADD, AlphaMissense, SIFT, PolyPhen-2, MetaRNN, GERP, PhyloP, and PhastCons scores in a single call. Use this when MyVariant_query_variants does not return dbnsfp data, or when you specifically need REVEL/AlphaMissense scores for ACMG PP3/BP4 classification. Coordinates default to hg19/GRCh37 -- set assembly='hg38' for hg38/GRCh38 (e.g. rs4244285 is chr10:g.96541616G>C on hg19 and chr10:g.94781859G>C on hg38). An HGVS variant_id must be written in the SAME assembly you request: this endpoint looks ids up verbatim and never lifts coordinates over, so an hg19 id with assembly='hg38' is a 404, not a translation. An rsID works in either assembly. The response reports the frame in a top-level 'coordinate_assembly' key. MyVariant sometimes files several records under one rsID and resolves the rsID to the highest-scoring one, which can be an identifier-only stub; when that happens the sibling records that do carry the requested fields are reported in the top-level 'sibling_records_with_requested_fields', 'sibling_variant_ids_with_requested_fields' and 'sibling_record_note' keys, and 'data' still holds the record MyVariant resolved.

variant_id.description: Variant ID: rsID (e.g., rs45478192) or HGVS genomic (e.g., chr16:g.23635348A>C). Both formats work; an HGVS id must be expressed in the assembly given by the 'assembly' parameter.

fields.description: Fields to return (pre-configured for pathogenicity scores)

assembly.description: Reference genome assembly for both the HGVS variant_id and the returned coordinates: 'hg19' (GRCh37, the default) or 'hg38' (GRCh38).

_id.description: MyVariant's identifier for the variant, in HGVS genomic form, e.g. 'chr16:g.23635348A>C'.

_license.description: CADD's licence. CADD is free for academic use only, and this is where that is stated.

phred.description: CADD PHRED score. 20 means the variant is in the most deleterious 1% of the genome, 30 the top 0.1%. A raw score is not comparable between CADD versions; the PHRED is.

rs.description: The GERP rejected-substitutions score. High means the position is conserved and a change there is more likely to matter.

rcv.description: One entry per ClinVar submission record. SEVERAL entries with DIFFERENT significances is the normal case for a disputed variant, and reading only the first hides the dispute.

clinical_significance.description: What that record asserts, e.g. 'Conflicting interpretations of pathogenicity' -- which is itself a verdict, not a missing one.

dbnsfp.description: dbNSFP's collected in-silico predictions. They are NOT independent: most are trained on overlapping data, so agreement between them is weaker evidence than it looks.

score.description: SIFT score per transcript -- a LIST, because the same variant has different consequences on different transcripts. Below 0.05 is called damaging.

pred.description: SIFT's call per transcript, 'D' damaging or 'T' tolerated.

hdiv.description: The HumDiv-trained model, for rare Mendelian variants.

pred.description: Its call: 'D' probably damaging, 'P' possibly damaging, 'B' benign.

hvar.description: The HumVar-trained model, for distinguishing severe from milder variants.

metarnn.description: MetaRNN, an ensemble that combines the other predictors.

revel.description: REVEL, an ensemble tuned for rare missense variants.

score.description: Score, 0 to 1. Above about 0.75 is commonly treated as supporting pathogenicity.

rankscore.description: Rank-normalised score. phyloP can be negative for faster-than-neutral sites, which the rankscore hides.
